import html def create_html_response(visitor_content: str) -> str: """ Construct an HTML response by safely inserting user-provided content into a predefined template. Parameters ---------- visitor_content : str Content supplied by the user that should be embedded in the page. Returns ------- str The complete HTML page with the user content inserted, properly escaped to prevent script injection attacks. """ # Define a minimal HTML template with a placeholder for user content html_template = """ Welcome Visitor

Hello, visitor!

{user_content}
""" # Escape the user content to neutralize any embedded scripts or markup safe_content = html.escape(visitor_content, quote=True) # Insert the escaped content into the template return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
